subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — Redwood & Acme follow-up
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jon Gray <jon.gray@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — Redwood & Acme follow-up

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo and discussion this morning. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can keep momentum: 

Pain points we surfaced:
- High inference latency on our current stack, particularly tail latency for conversational flows (95th percentile ~1.8s).
- Token costs are ballooning for customer-facing features; need predictable unit economics.
- Data residency / audit logs are mandatory for our EU and US customers.

Goals / success criteria:
- POC demonstrating 40% median latency improvement and predictable 95th percentile under our traffic profile.
- Cost reduction target of ~30% per 1M tokens.
- Clear path to SOC2 evidence and KMS integration for production.

Stakeholders: Jon Gray (CTO), me (Product Lead), Procurement (Tina Alvarez — will loop in once we have MAP/SOW).
Proposed timeline (high-level):
- POC kickoff: week of 3/29
- Technical eval complete: by 4/15
- Procurement & decision: target 5/1

Next asks: could you share a Mutual Action Plan with milestones, owners, and dates + a draft SOW so Procurement has something to review? Also can we schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra team to validate KV cache and quantization approach (2-3 engineers + Jon + me).

Thanks — excited to keep moving.

Samantha Lee
Product Lead, Platform
Acme Corp
(samantha.lee@acme.com)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Jon Gray <jon.gray@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — Redwood & Acme follow-up

Thanks for the clear recap, Samantha — appreciate the detail. Agreed on the goals and timeline. I’ve attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (Acme_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf) and a SOW template for Procurement to review (SOW_template.docx). High-level MAP I propose: 

1) POC kickoff (owner: Redwood / Marissa) — target week of 3/29
   - Deliverable: hosted POC environment, sample traffic replay, initial latency/cost baseline
2) Deep technical review (owner: Rishi) — target 3/24 (one-hour deep-dive)
   - Focus: KV cache behavior, quantization options, expected throughput on your instance types
3) Security & compliance checklist (owner: Dev) — deliver by 3/22
   - Deliverable: SOC2 artifacts, KMS integration plan, retention/audit log details
4) POC evaluation & optimization (owner: Rishi/Marissa) — complete by 4/15
5) Procurement & contract review (owner: Acme / Tina) — target decision 5/1

Can you confirm the right procurement contact (Tina Alvarez?) and whether Jon wants a separate exec sync? For the deep-dive, are these times workable: Wed 3/24 at 11:00am PT or Thu 3/25 at 9:00am PT? I’ll put a calendar hold for 3/24 11:00am PT for now.

Attaching: Acme_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf (MAP with milestones/RACI) and SOW_template.docx.

Quick notes: we can provide a short-lived dedicated demo environment for the POC and enable region pinning for data residency. Rishi will surface any model/quantization recommendations after the deep-dive.

Next steps:
- Samantha to confirm procurement contact & stakeholders (Procurement, Legal)
- Confirm deep-dive attendees & time (we have 3/24 11am PT hold)
- Rishi & Dev to prepare security checklist + demo env plan

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0134

[Attachment: Acme_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf] [Attachment: SOW_template.docx]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jon Gray <jon.gray@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — Redwood & Acme follow-up

Looping in with a couple technical confirmations. Thanks, Marissa/Samantha.

- We can provision a demo cluster in us-west1 and enable region pinning for the POC.
- For the latency target (40% median improvement and <1.2s p95), we’ll need a short traffic replay describing sequence length distribution; can Acme share a 24-48 hour sample (anonymized) before 3/24?
- Quantization: initial POC will use 4-bit quantization profile to reduce memory/throughput costs; we’ll run accuracy checks against your eval set during the POC.
- Security: Dev will own the SOC2 artifact pack; target to deliver by 3/22 as Marissa noted.

Proposed owners:
- POC infra & demo env: Rishi (Redwood)
- Security artifacts & KMS details: Dev (Redwood)
- Procurement coordination: Marissa (sales) + Tina (Acme)

I’ll prepare a short tech-brief PDF for the deep-dive; Marissa, should I drop that in the Drive link you provided?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jon Gray <jon.gray@acme.com>, Tina Alvarez <tina.alvarez@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — Redwood & Acme follow-up

Marissa / Rishi — thanks, this looks good and aligned with what we discussed. A few quick confirmations: 

- Procurement lead: Tina Alvarez (tina.alvarez@acme.com) — I’ve cc’d her.
- Deep-dive: 3/24 11:00am PT works for Jon and two engineers (I’ll send invites).
- We’ll share an anonymized 48h traffic sample by EOD 3/22 (via the Drive link).
- Security artifacts: please send SOC2 checklist + KMS plan by 3/22.
- POC acceptance criteria: we’ll use the latency & cost targets as listed; please call out the exact test harness and metrics in the MAP.

Also, can you include procurement payment/contact details in the SOW so Tina has what she needs to start the internal process?

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.
